WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx) as ratio_avg,
    SUM(sp.aream2) / SUM(sp.volm3) as area_volume_ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_volume_ratio) as avg_area_volume_ratio
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  s1.fundflux,
  s1.ratio_avg,
  s1.area_volume_ratio,
  s1.area_volume_ratio - s2.avg_area_volume_ratio as difference
FROM step1 s1
CROSS JOIN step2 s2
WHERE s1.area_volume_ratio > s2.avg_area_volume_ratio
